structured_output.what_is_happening: SDOG "Sitting Dog" (yFcT…pump) is a pump.fun coin created about 08:27 UTC that moved to PumpSwap around 08:39 UTC. At detection it was at a $58k market cap, and $66k by T2, after a +158% 5-minute spike. Its 1-hour volume is about $150k and liquidity about $21.6k, per DexScreener. It is one of at least 10 "Sitting Dog"/SDOG tokens launched within minutes of each other, which points to a meme (probably from a TikTok video) being farmed by launch bots. The volume leader of that cluster is a different token: vpccb9DN… on PumpSwap, at about $108k market cap, $33k liquidity, about $897k of 1-hour volume and +851% in 1 hour. Another one, 5RrRz…, did $1.86M of volume and now has $0 liquidity. The trigger-time 5-minute spike on this token looks like spillover from the leader rather than its own attention. The deployer, per GMGN, has launched 2,441 tokens and has already closed their position. The coin is flagged as a community takeover (CTO), and its only socials are someone else's X status link and a TikTok video link.

narrative.description: A 'Sitting Dog' animal meme, apparently sourced from a TikTok video (@thaianhh1011) and an X post by 000xy_0. The packet links both, but neither could be read (X returned 402 and TikTok returned no content). I could not confirm on the open web that it is a viral trend.
narrative.why_spreading: At least 10 same-name tokens were launched within about 20 minutes, and one of them did roughly $1.8M of 1-hour volume. That points to a short-lived pump.fun meta, and possibly a real viral clip. Beyond on-chain copycat launches, I found no web or news evidence of an event that is growing.

structural_risks: A secondary SDOG token competing for the same attention against a leader with 6x the volume
Serial deployer (2,441 launches) who has already exited
187 bundler wallets; bundlers hold about 23% of top traders
About $21k liquidity against about $150k of 1-hour volume, so it moves easily in both directions
The +158% 5-minute spike may simply be a spillover wick that fades
LP is burned, so a classic liquidity pull is unlikely, but the pair can bleed to death

A move from $66k to $130k market cap is small in absolute terms, and it just printed +158% in 5 minutes.

structured_output.thesis: This is a secondary clone in a bot-farmed 'Sitting Dog' meta. Doubling from entry would mean overtaking the leader's market cap, which is unlikely. Fade.
